meta.note: Every rule carries the URL it was read from and the sentence it was read out of. tests/test_rulebook.py fails the suite on any rule that does not. Where the city publishes a cure path but no deadline, window_days is null on purpose and the deadline engine refuses to invent one: the item goes to DECIDE with the question handed back to the contractor.
known_conflicts: Permit duration. Admin Code 28-105.8.1 says 'Permits may be issued for a period of up to 2 years unless otherwise limited by law' (as amended by L.L. 2025/048, effective 2026-01-12). The DOB permit renewal page still describes a one year term as one of the earliest-of triggers. Lapse does not compute a term from either: it reads the expiration_date DOB printed on the permit record.

Renewal window anchor. Admin Code 28-105.9.1 allows reinstatement 'within a period of two years from the date of issuance of the original permit'. The DOB permit renewal page says renewals are issued on permits 'that have expired but have activity on the application within a two-year period of the permit expiration date'. Those are different anchor dates. grace_days below is 730 anchored to expiry, following the operational DOB page, and this conflict is recorded rather than hidden.
meta.provenance: Every quote below was read out of the document at its citation URL, contiguously, not assembled from passages in different subdivisions. tests/test_rulebook.py -m live fetches each citation and asserts the quote appears in the fetched text, so a spliced or invented quote fails rather than merely looking plausible.

permits.label: Equipment work permit
permits.action: Renew it in the system it was issued in, DOB NOW: Build or eFiling, before the expiry date. A renewal without change goes through eFiling by the permit applicant; a renewal with change needs a completed PW2 at a borough office.
permits.artifact: DOB NOW: Build or eFiling permit renewal, PW2 if anything changed, $130 renewal fee
permits.lapsed_question: Was any work done on this site after the permit expired? If nothing was done, DOB waives the unpermitted work penalty and this is a clean renewal. If work continued, the penalty has to be paid before the renewal can be issued at all.
permits.quote: Permits are renewed in the system in which they were issued: DOB NOW: Build or eFiling / Buildings Information System (BIS). Permit renewals are issued on active permits and permits that have expired but have activity on the application within a two-year period of the permit expiration date for various types of construction within the five boroughs.

permits.label: New building permit
permits.action: Renew it in DOB NOW: Build before the expiry date. A new building permit that lapses while the structure is going up stops the job, and DOB will not issue the renewal until any unpermitted work penalty is paid.
permits.artifact: DOB NOW: Build permit renewal, $130 renewal fee
permits.lapsed_question: Was any construction done on this site after the permit expired? If nothing was done, DOB waives the unpermitted work penalty and this is a clean renewal. If work continued, the penalty has to be paid before the renewal can be issued at all.
permits.quote: Permits are renewed in the system in which they were issued: DOB NOW: Build or eFiling / Buildings Information System (BIS). Permit renewals are issued on active permits and permits that have expired but have activity on the application within a two-year period of the permit expiration date for various types of construction within the five boroughs.

permits.label: Construction equipment permit
permits.action: Renew it in the system it was issued in before the expiry date. Note that temporary construction equipment is treated differently from other permits when an expired permit is waived: sidewalk sheds are expressly carved out of the waiver.
permits.artifact: DOB NOW: Build or eFiling permit renewal, $130 renewal fee
permits.lapsed_question: Was the equipment still up, or still in use, after the permit expired? If it came down before the expiry date DOB waives the penalty. If it stayed up, the unpermitted work penalty applies and has to be paid before the renewal.
permits.quote: Where a permit (other than for temporary construction equipment) expired and no work was performed after the permit’s expiration.

permits.label: Foundation and earthwork permit
permits.action: Renew it in the system it was issued in, DOB NOW: Build or eFiling, before the expiry date. Foundation work that continues past expiry is work without a permit and the penalty has to be cleared before the renewal is issued.
permits.artifact: DOB NOW: Build or eFiling permit renewal, $130 renewal fee
permits.lapsed_question: Was any excavation or foundation work done on this site after the permit expired? If nothing was done, DOB waives the unpermitted work penalty and this is a clean renewal. If work continued, the penalty has to be paid before the renewal can be issued at all.
permits.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this section, payment of the civil penalty is required before: (1) Issuance of a permit for work in a particular space when work was performed without a permit in such space and the penalty for such unpermitted work has not been paid. (2) Renewal of a permit for work performed after the expiration of a permit when the penalty for such unpermitted work has not been paid.

permits.label: Demolition permit
permits.action: Renew it in the system it was issued in before the expiry date. A demolition that runs past its permit is work without a permit on a site where the hazard is already elevated.
permits.artifact: DOB NOW: Build or eFiling permit renewal, $130 renewal fee
permits.lapsed_question: Was any demolition done on this site after the permit expired? If nothing was done, DOB waives the unpermitted work penalty and this is a clean renewal. If work continued, the penalty has to be paid before the renewal can be issued at all.
permits.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this section, payment of the civil penalty is required before: (1) Issuance of a permit for work in a particular space when work was performed without a permit in such space and the penalty for such unpermitted work has not been paid. (2) Renewal of a permit for work performed after the expiration of a permit when the penalty for such unpermitted work has not been paid.

violations.label: Low pressure boiler, inspection report not filed
violations.action: Either provide proof the inspection report for that cycle year was already filed, or pay the civil penalty and file a current inspection report in DOB NOW: Safety. The report for a cycle can only be filed late until 14 January of the following year; after that DOB requires a fresh inspection for the current cycle.
violations.artifact: Low pressure boiler annual inspection report in DOB NOW: Safety, plus the civil penalty
violations.quote: Late filing. An inspection report or any part of that report filed after the fourteen (14) day filing deadline but in no event later than January 14th of the calendar year immediately following the inspection cycle.
violations.respondent_quote: The owner shall be responsible for hiring a qualified boiler inspector to conduct inspections and file low pressure boiler annual inspection reports pursuant to Article 303 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code

violations.label: High pressure boiler, inspection report not filed
violations.action: Either provide proof the inspection report for that cycle year was already filed, or pay the civil penalty and file a current inspection report in DOB NOW: Safety. Internal and external high pressure inspections are separate filings and a violation names which one is missing.
violations.artifact: High pressure boiler inspection report in DOB NOW: Safety, plus the civil penalty
violations.quote: Late filing. An inspection report or any part of that report filed after the fourteen (14) day filing deadline but in no event later than January 14th of the calendar year immediately following the inspection cycle
violations.respondent_quote: The owner shall be responsible for hiring a qualified boiler inspector to conduct inspections and tests and file high pressure boiler annual inspection reports pursuant to Article 303 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code.

violations.label: Failure to certify correction of an immediately hazardous (Class 1) summons
violations.action: Correct the condition and file a Certificate of Correction in DOB NOW: Safety, or challenge the AEUHAZ violation within 30 days of the issue date. A Class 1 summons at a construction site larger than four families that is not certified draws a further $5,000 and a re-inspection every 60 days.
violations.artifact: Certificate of Correction in DOB NOW: Safety
violations.quote: The property owner and/or respondent may submit a challenge to the AEUHAZ violation within 30 days of the Notice of Violation issued date.
violations.respondent_quote: The property owner and/or respondent may submit a challenge to the AEUHAZ violation within 30 days of the Notice of Violation issued date.

violations.label: Construction violation
violations.action: Correct the condition and give proof of the correction to the unit that issued it, and pay any DOB civil penalty. There is no court appearance on a DOB violation, and there is no published number of days, so how fast this moves is set by the job rather than by a rule.
violations.artifact: Proof of correction to the issuing unit, plus any civil penalty
violations.quote: To remove a DOB violation from a property record, the condition must be corrected and proof of that correction must be provided to the issuing unit.

violations.label: Elevator violation
violations.action: Provide a letter and proof of compliance such as the filed inspection and test report for the cycle year, or pay the civil penalties per device and file a current inspection and test report in DOB NOW: Safety. Periodic inspection reports are due within 14 days of the inspection and category test reports within 21 days of the test.
violations.artifact: Elevator inspection and test report (CAT1 or CAT5) in DOB NOW: Safety, plus civil penalties per device
violations.quote: Provide a letter and proof of compliance, such as a copy of the filed inspection and test report(s) for the applicable cycle year; or, Submit to the Department payment of the appropriate civil penalties per device and filing of a current inspection and test report(s) in DOB NOW: Safety.

violations.label: Local Law 10 of 1981, elevator inspection report not filed
violations.action: Same path as any elevator violation: proof the report for that cycle was filed, or payment of the civil penalties plus a current CAT1 or CAT5 report in accepted status in DOB NOW: Safety. Violations issued before 2016 clear on payment alone; 2017 and later need the report as well.
violations.artifact: CAT1 or CAT5 inspection report in DOB NOW: Safety, plus civil penalties
violations.quote: Violations issued prior to 2016 are dismissed within 1 to 10 days depending on the form of payment. Violations from 2017 or later require payment and a current CAT1 or CAT5 inspection report in accepted status to have been filed in DOB NOW: Safety.

violations.label: Facade Inspection Safety Program, report not filed or filed late
violations.action: A QEWI has to file the outstanding acceptable Technical Report on the periodic inspection of exterior walls in DOB NOW: Safety, and the late filing penalties have to be paid. Penalties run at $1,000 for every month an acceptable report is not filed and $5,000 for each year past the end of the sub-cycle window.
violations.artifact: Technical Report, Periodic Inspection of Exterior Walls and Appurtenances, in DOB NOW: Safety
violations.quote: A QEWI must submit the outstanding acceptable initial Technical Report Periodic Inspection of Exterior Walls and Appurtenances in DOB NOW: Safety. Pay the late filing penalties owed - $1,000 for every month that an acceptable report is not filed and $5,000 for each year after the end of the sub-cycle filing window period that an acceptable report is not filed.
violations.respondent_quote: The owner of the building is responsible for ensuring that the conditions described in the critical examination report as unsafe are corrected and all actions recommended by the QEWI are completed within this timeframe.

violations.label: Retaining wall, report not filed
violations.action: A QRWI has to file the outstanding acceptable retaining wall condition assessment report in DOB NOW: Safety. Retaining wall filing windows run by borough on a five year cycle, not by block digit the way facades do, so which window applies depends on where the wall is.
violations.artifact: Retaining wall condition assessment report in DOB NOW: Safety
violations.quote: Filing window. The one-year period during which an acceptable report for a particular retaining wall may be filed with the Department without penalty.
violations.respondent_quote: The owner of the retaining wall is responsible for ensuring that the conditions described in the report of critical examination as safe with repair and/or engineering monitoring are corrected and all actions recommended by the QRWI are completed

violations.label: Plumbing violation
violations.action: Correct the condition and give proof of the correction to the unit that issued it, and pay any DOB civil penalty. There is no court appearance on a DOB violation and no published number of days.
violations.artifact: Proof of correction to the issuing unit, plus any civil penalty
violations.quote: To remove a DOB violation from a property record, the condition must be corrected and proof of that correction must be provided to the issuing unit.

violations.label: Boiler violation
violations.action: Provide proof the inspection report for the cycle year was filed, or pay the civil penalties and file a current inspection report in DOB NOW: Safety.
violations.artifact: Boiler inspection report in DOB NOW: Safety, plus civil penalties
violations.quote: To remedy a notice of violation for failure to file a periodic boiler inspection report: Provide proof of compliance, such as a copy of the filed inspection report for the applicable cycle year; or Submit to the Department payment of the appropriate civil penalties and filing of a current inspection report in DOB NOW: Safety.
violations.respondent_quote: The owner shall be responsible for hiring a qualified boiler inspector to conduct inspections and file low pressure boiler annual inspection reports pursuant to Article 303 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code

violations.label: Unsafe building
violations.action: Correct the unsafe condition and give proof to the issuing unit. An unsafe building violation is not a paperwork item and the condition itself has to be dealt with before anything else moves.
violations.artifact: Proof of correction to the issuing unit, plus any civil penalty
violations.quote: To remove a DOB violation from a property record, the condition must be corrected and proof of that correction must be provided to the issuing unit.

violations.label: Zoning violation
violations.action: Correct the condition or legalise it, then give proof of the correction to the unit that issued it, and pay any DOB civil penalty.
violations.artifact: Proof of correction to the issuing unit, plus any civil penalty
violations.quote: To remove a DOB violation from a property record, the condition must be corrected and proof of that correction must be provided to the issuing unit.

lapsed_answers.note: What a contractor's answer to the lapsed permit question changes. The question is which of these two provisions applies, and only somebody who was on the site can say. Both quotes are verbatim from 1 RCNY 102-04 and are verified by tests/test_rulebook_provenance.py.

no.label: No work was done after the permit expired
no.action: Renew it. DOB waives the unpermitted work penalty where a permit expired and nothing was done after it, so this is a clean renewal with the standard fee and no penalty to clear first.
no.quote: Where a permit (other than for temporary construction equipment) expired and no work was performed after the permit’s expiration.

yes.label: Work continued after the permit expired
yes.action: The unpermitted work penalty has to be paid before DOB will issue the renewal at all. Pay it, then renew. Do not file the renewal first and expect it to go through.
yes.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this section, payment of the civil penalty is required before: (1) Issuance of a permit for work in a particular space when work was performed without a permit in such space and the penalty for such unpermitted work has not been paid. (2) Renewal of a permit for work performed after the expiration of a permit when the penalty for such unpermitted work has not been paid.
